req.title: DELETE is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for subsequent DELETE calls on the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-028 requires DELETE /tasks/{task_id} to be idempotent: the first call on an existing task returns HTTP 204, and every subsequent call on the same task_id returns HTTP 404. The test suite covers: (1) positive – first DELETE succeeds with 204, second DELETE returns 404 (STC: created→deleted→not-found); (2) negative – DELETE on a never-existing task_id returns 404 immediately (NEG); (3) boundary – DELETE exactly three times on the same id, verifying 204 then 404 then 404 (BVA: boundary between 'exists' and 'gone' states). Each test uses an in-process SQLite database via FastAPI TestClient with dependency override to guarantee isolation.

tests.name: test_delete_idempotent_first_204_second_404
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task and capture task_id
DELETE /tasks/{task_id} — second call on same task_id
expected: First DELETE returns HTTP 204 with empty body
Second DELETE response body contains detail message referencing the task_id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_t = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r028_pos.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_t)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_t)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_idempotent_first_204_second_404():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "idempotent task", "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]

    r1 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    assert r1.content == b""

    r2 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    detail = r2.json()["detail"]
    assert str(task_id) in detail

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
import os
try:
    os.remove("./test_r028_pos.db")
except OSError:
    pass

tests.name: test_delete_does_not_affect_other_tasks
preconditions: Two tasks are created: task_a and task_b
actions: POST /tasks/ twice to create task_a and task_b
GET /tasks/{task_b_id} to verify task_b is unaffected
expected: GET on task_b returns 200 with correct id and title
trace: R-TASK-028: idempotent DELETE must not corrupt sibling resources
DT: decision table row — delete task_a twice, task_b untouched
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_t = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r028_dt.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_t)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_t)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_does_not_affect_other_tasks():
    ra = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task alpha", "completed": False})
    assert ra.status_code == 201
    id_a = ra.json()["id"]

    rb = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task beta", "completed": False})
    assert rb.status_code == 201
    id_b = rb.json()["id"]

    r1 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{id_a}")
    assert r1.status_code == 204

    r2 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{id_a}")
    assert r2.status_code == 404

    r_get_b = client.get(f"/tasks/{id_b}")
    assert r_get_b.status_code == 200
    body_b = r_get_b.json()
    assert body_b["id"] == id_b
    assert body_b["title"] == "task beta"
    assert body_b["completed"] == False

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
import os
try:
    os.remove("./test_r028_dt.db")
except OSError:
    pass
